method: Canonical combination IDs, unique partner→runner continuation pass and actual completed reception at the canonical combination completion timestamp. Subsequent choices/shots require this runner and the same control chain, ending at their next physical pass. A shot must link the same canonical continuation Pass ID (or its actual first-time contact). Later recycled attacks in the same episode are excluded. Raw broad same-episode hints are retained but never used as causal conversion. Unknown/ambiguous links are left unattributed.
